name: google-ads-campaigns
description: Plan Google Ads Search keywords and draft ads from your brief. Reviews Google Ads search terms, negative keywords, conversions, bidding and Performance Max using reports and settings you supply. Use when you ask “plan Search ads”, “review these search terms” or “check our bidding settings”. Works from pasted text, exports or screenshots. It also explains access setup; live account work needs separate tools and checks that the connection works. Not for automatic campaign changes, launching ads or promises of better performance. No connector is included.
